maintenance_led.reason: Sells potash, Trio fertilizer, salt and water as consumables for agriculture, feed and oil and gas; used up, not maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private farmers, fertilizer distributors, feed makers and oil and gas operators paying commercially.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by mining and selling potash, Trio and water from its own New Mexico and Utah operations, not acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Potash and langbeinite fertilizer are largely commodity products; buyers can switch suppliers on price and delivery.
